question: In a certain code language, 'PRESENT' is coded as '79510552'. How will 'STATE' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

**Logic :**

 
• **Each letter's position value is written.**
 
• **Two digit position value are added within.**

So,

 
• PRESENT is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768b386d56f016809a7bddaf16228bef1acc5912540cd3b0104b45eaa57ea624.png] 

Similarly,

 
• STATE is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e211b7ad9e0c517ffa29bc5895dc47bc6032d40dda96d6d393f9cae9dac14a1f.png] 

Hence, **"****102125"** is the correct answer.
